title: Karim in Moscow, ep. 1: coffee
caption:
Karim's first coffee in Moscow, episode 1.
Мо́жно ко́фе? = Can I have a coffee? One word, мо́жно, works in every café and shop.
What would you order? Answer in Russian in the comments.
